free_for_all.scoreboard: Real-time display showing eliminations and current rank.
free_for_all.elimination_buff: Instantly restores HP & EP and repairs armor durability.
free_for_all.armor_durability: Durability can be fully restored upon acquiring elimination buff.
free_for_all.revival_mechanic: Spawns player at the least crowded nearby revival point.
free_for_all.match_start_prep: Players visible to each other but immobilized during countdown; can browse store.
free_for_all.weapon_purchase_window: Store stays open post-revival until player fires their first shot.

big_head_mode.level_up_buffs: Grants OP buffs upon head level-ups and revivals.
big_head_mode.ui_optimizations: Clearer head level progress, real-time rank/total rank, and score/total score display.
big_head_mode.performance: Warm-up stage added at game start to optimize low-end devices.
